patient_description: I feel sick.

patient_description: The pain is going down my arm and into my jaw.

patient_description: It hurts more when I press on my chest or twist.

patient_description: I've got a burning feeling behind my breastbone after eating.

patient_description: I haven't wanted to eat anything.

patient_description: The pain started around my belly button and moved down to the right.

patient_description: I've got a terrible pain in my side, round to my back.

patient_description: I'm so thirsty all the time and I keep weeing.

patient_description: The pain is up here under my right ribs, especially after fatty food.

patient_description: It's a terrible pain in the top of my stomach that goes straight through to my back.

patient_description: I've been sick and there was blood in it.

patient_description: My stools have gone black and sticky.

patient_description: I've come out in an itchy, lumpy rash.

patient_description: My lips and tongue are swelling up.

name: Swollen calf
patient_description: One calf is swollen and tight.

name: Light hurts the eyes
patient_description: The light is hurting my eyes.

name: Lower abdominal pain
patient_description: I've got cramping pain low down in my tummy.

name: Shoulder tip pain
patient_description: There's an odd pain in the tip of my shoulder.

name: Passing very little urine
patient_description: I've hardly passed any water today.

name: Shaking
patient_description: I feel shaky.

name: Unable to bear weight
patient_description: I can't put any weight on it at all.

patient_description: My leg looks shorter and my foot's turned out.

patient_description: It came on like being hit on the back of the head: the worst headache of my life.

patient_description: My neck is really stiff.

name: Slurred speech

name: Face drooping on one side
patient_description: One side of my face has dropped.

patient_description: It's a sharp pain in my chest when I breathe in.

patient_description: I've been coughing up blood.

patient_description: My tummy is all swollen and tight.

patient_description: There's a painful lump in my groin that won't go back in.

patient_description: I've got a really painful swelling by my bottom.

name: Sudden severe tummy pain
patient_description: The pain came on all of a sudden, it's the worst I've ever had.
